subject: Introduction to Special Education
overview: Lisa Kingsley and David Kingsley discussed the fundamentals of special education, focusing on federal mandates and the collaborative process between families and schools.

items.title: Introductory remarks
items.summary: The speakers introduced the sixth installment of their educational chat series.

items.title: Definition of special education
items.summary: Lisa Kingsley explained that special education is governed by the federal Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA) and ensures students receive a free and appropriate public education.

items.title: Individualized Education Program (IEP) overview
items.summary: The discussion identified the IEP as a foundation for special education services, outlining specific instruction, accommodations, and modifications agreed upon by families and school staff.

items.title: School Committee oversight and platform
items.summary: The chat concluded with a preview of an upcoming discussion regarding how special education oversight intersects with the role of the School Committee.
